details.name: Celsius To Fahrenheit Conversion
details.description: Construct a program that computes the Fahrenheit equivalent of an input Celsius value using the formula F = (9/5)C + 32. The input Celsius value is an integer.

details.name: Fahrenheit to Celsius Conversion
details.description: Construct a program that computes the Celsius equivalent of an input Fahrenheit value using the formula C = (F - 32) (5/9). The input Fahrenheit value is an integer.
